inputs.name: LocalTransportService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Optional settings: origin is the exact Origin header the transport accepts, ticketMs is a ticket's lifetime in milliseconds, tickets is the most tickets that may wait, clients is the most open connections, and now is the clock for ticket expiry (Date.now() when omitted). An omitted origin, ticketMs, tickets or clients uses its localTransport default from the remote package.

inputs.name: LocalTransportService.bootstrap.target
inputs.description: The client that one ticket is issued for: bootstrap stores it with the ticket, and the socket admitted on that ticket is passed to its attach() method. forget matches it by identity, so only tickets issued for this exact object are removed.

inputs.name: LocalTransportService.forget.target
inputs.description: The client whose tickets forget removes, matched by identity against the target each stored ticket was issued for. A target with no stored tickets changes nothing.

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.port
outputs.description: The TCP port of the bound server on 127.0.0.1, which the operating system picks because the server starts on port 0. It throws while no server is bound, that is before listen() resolves and after close().

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.address
outputs.description: The IP address the server is bound to, which is always 127.0.0.1 because start() passes that host. It throws the same error as port while no server is bound.

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.connections
outputs.description: The number of WebSocket clients the server currently has open, which never exceeds the clients limit. It is 0 before listen() resolves and after close().

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.listen
outputs.description: A promise that resolves with the bound port once the server is listening, and repeated calls share that same promise. If starting fails, the promise rejects and the next call starts the server again.

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.bootstrap
outputs.description: A new one-use ticket for one client, returned together with the port to connect to. The ticket is 32 random bytes encoded as base64url, and it stops opening a socket once its ticketMs lifetime has passed.

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.forget
outputs.description: Returns nothing. It deletes every stored ticket whose target is the given object, so those tickets can no longer open a socket, and it does not close sockets that are already open.

outputs.name: LocalTransportService.close
outputs.description: A promise that resolves once every open socket has been terminated and the server has closed. It resolves even if listen() failed, and it does nothing when no server is running.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by the port and address getters and by bootstrap while no server is bound, that is before listen() resolves or after close(). The message is 'The transport is not listening.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejection of listen() with the error that starting the WebSocket server fails with, such as an 'error' event emitted before it is listening. The cached start promise is cleared, so a later listen() call starts the server again.
